serialization: FOR JSON PATH, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES; ORDER BY PK; SHA2_256 de NVARCHAR; no compara paginas fisicas

constraints.name: CK_Opciones_PreferenciaHorarioLead
constraints.definicion: (([pref_dia_semana_lead] IS NULL OR [pref_dia_semana_lead]>=(1) AND [pref_dia_semana_lead]<=(7)) AND ([pref_hora_inicio_lead] IS NULL AND [pref_hora_fin_lead] IS NULL OR [pref_hora_inicio_lead] IS NOT NULL AND [pref_hora_fin_lead] IS NOT NULL AND [pref_hora_inicio_lead]<[pref_hora_fin_lead]))

constraints.name: CK_PropuestasLead_ArbolVersion
constraints.definicion: ([id_propuesta_raiz] IS NULL AND [numero_version]=(1) OR [id_propuesta_raiz] IS NOT NULL AND [numero_version]>(1))

constraints.name: CK_Reservas_Estado
constraints.definicion: ([estado]='Vencida' OR [estado]='No asistió' OR [estado]='Cancelada' OR [estado]='Atendida' OR [estado]='Confirmada' OR [estado]='Bloqueada' OR [estado]='Pendiente')

constraints.name: CK_Solicitudes_ResultadoComercialLead
constraints.definicion: ([resultado_comercial_lead] IS NULL AND [fecha_decision_comercial_lead] IS NULL AND [valor_acordado_lead] IS NULL AND [id_propuesta_aceptada_lead] IS NULL OR [resultado_comercial_lead]='PENDIENTE' AND [fecha_decision_comercial_lead] IS NULL AND [valor_acordado_lead] IS NULL AND [id_propuesta_aceptada_lead] IS NULL OR [resultado_comercial_lead]='ACEPTADA' AND [fecha_decision_comercial_lead] IS NOT NULL AND [valor_acordado_lead] IS NOT NULL AND [id_propuesta_aceptada_lead] IS NOT NULL AND [motivo_cierre_lead] IS NULL OR [resultado_comercial_lead]='CERRADA_SIN_ACUERDO' AND [fecha_decision_comercial_lead] IS NOT NULL AND [valor_acordado_lead] IS NULL AND [id_propuesta_aceptada_lead] IS NULL AND nullif(ltrim(rtrim([motivo_cierre_lead])),'') IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: CK_Solicitudes_ValorYFechaLead
constraints.definicion: (([valor_acordado_lead] IS NULL OR [valor_acordado_lead]>=(0)) AND ([fecha_decision_comercial_lead] IS NULL OR [fecha_decision_comercial_lead]>=[fecha_solicitud]))
